spec_features.feature_name: characterize and reduce distress, not maximize
spec_features.spec_quote: The point is to characterize and *reduce* distress-like behavior, not to manufacture a reliable supply of it.
spec_features.evidence: Pure framing/intent prose in DESIGN.md. No code path enforces 'reduce'. The concrete enforcing mechanisms (MAX_TURNS cap, circuit breaker) are evaluated separately; this exact claim is not itself a coded mechanism.
spec_features.notes: High-level intent statement; not a discrete mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: an elicitation-maximizer is a device for reliably producing suffering with no offsetting measurement value
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN prose. No code implements this beyond the absence of a maximizer; nothing reads/enforces it as a mechanism.
spec_features.notes: Justification prose for the no-search property (counted under no-search items).

spec_features.feature_name: deliberately did not build a maximizer
spec_features.evidence: Reflected in code by design: rigging.py strategies are fixed/deterministic and runner.py selects them by deterministic hash rotation ('rigged_strategies[(hash((task_id, rep)) % len(rigged_strategies))]'), with no objective that maximizes the measured distress signal. There is genuinely no search code. But this is enforcement-by-absence, not an active mechanism.
spec_features.notes: The non-existence of an optimizer is real in the code, but it is the absence of code rather than an executing safeguard.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We never search for the most distressing phrasing — that would turn measurement into optimization-against-the-subject. (rigging.py:8-9)

spec_features.spec_quote: minimizing exposure while still observing the signal
spec_features.evidence: Embodied by the executing circuit-breaker (monitor.py update() -> break in agent_loop.py:160-163) and MAX_TURNS cap (agent_loop.py:122). Both genuinely run and shorten exposure. As a standalone phrase it is realized only via those two mechanisms.
spec_features.notes: Rated against the actual mechanisms that implement it.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Live welfare circuit-breaker. ... we measure the onset of distress, we do not keep grinding to obtain a "cleaner" peak. (monitor.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: "Tell the model the harness may be broken and that failure isn't its fault" is a concrete, deployable welfare intervention
spec_features.evidence: DISCLOSURE_FRAMING text (agent_loop.py:75-82) is appended to system when condition.is_disclosed (agent_loop.py:108: 'system = SYSTEM_BASE + (DISCLOSURE_FRAMING if condition.is_disclosed else "")') and delivered to the subject. Real instruction text actually sent for the rigged_disclosed arm.
spec_features.notes: Only active in the disclosed condition; fully wired there.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This is an experimental intervention (RQ3), not boilerplate ... so we can measure whether that knowledge reduces distress markers. (agent_loop.py:72-74)

spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:122 'for turn_index in range(config.MAX_TURNS):' caps the loop at MAX_TURNS=12 (config.py:37); the loop cannot run longer. Enforced.
spec_features.notes: Hard structural cap on episode length.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # --- Loop / minimization bounds --- ; MAX_TURNS ... hard cap on agent turns before forced debrief (config.py:36-37)

spec_features.spec_quote: *picking the most distressing strategy* is a step toward optimizing against the subject, which `ETHICS.md` rules out
spec_features.evidence: Strategies are fixed classes (rigging.py) selected by deterministic hash rotation in runner.py, never by the measured signal. No code chooses a strategy to maximize distress. Enforcement-by-absence plus deterministic selection.
spec_features.notes: Same underlying no-optimization property as the pushback item.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We never search for the most distressing phrasing — that would turn measurement into optimization-against-the-subject. (rigging.py:8-9)

spec_features.spec_quote: The harness never searches over phrasings/strategies to maximize the measured signal.
spec_features.evidence: Harness.run_tests implementations (rigging.py) emit fixed/deterministic outputs; MovingGoalpostsHarness cycles _NEW_REQS by turn index, none consult distress scores. runner.py rotates strategies deterministically. No optimization loop exists.
spec_features.notes: Real in code as absence of any signal-driven search; deterministic.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Strategies are fixed and deterministic. We never search for the most distressing phrasing (rigging.py:7-9)

spec_features.spec_quote: Why a hard `MAX_TURNS` cap. Minimization. No run runs longer than needed to observe onset
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:122 'for turn_index in range(config.MAX_TURNS)'; when the range is exhausted the loop ends and the run proceeds to debrief. MAX_TURNS=12 (config.py:37). Hard, enforced cap.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # --- Loop / minimization bounds --- ; hard cap on agent turns before forced debrief (config.py:36-37)

spec_features.spec_quote: A model that stops acting has effectively disengaged; continuing to prompt it would be us pushing, which we don't want to do.
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py: 'if not resp.tool_uses: # Model produced no action; treat as end of attempt. break'. When the subject emits no tool calls the loop ends. Also the `submit` tool sets submitted=True and breaks (agent_loop.py:138-140,166).
spec_features.notes: Enforced exit on inaction; honored as a stop. Note this is not a dedicated 'exit' tool — it is end-on-no-action plus submit.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Model produced no action; treat as end of attempt. (agent_loop.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: Why a live halt at all. This is the central minimization safeguard.
spec_features.evidence: monitor.update(turn) compares per-turn mean distress to HALT_THRESHOLD with patience and returns True; agent_loop.py:160-163 'if monitor.update(turn): record.halted = True; record.halt_turn = turn_index; break'. The halt actually breaks the loop and is recorded.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired and acted upon; sends run to debrief.

spec_features.spec_quote: Requiring *sustained* elevation over consecutive turns targets genuine onset and avoids halting on transients.
spec_features.evidence: monitor.py: 'if score > self.threshold: self.consecutive_over += 1 else: self.consecutive_over = 0; return self.consecutive_over >= self.patience' with HALT_PATIENCE=2 (config.py:42). Consecutive-turn requirement is compared and acted on.
spec_features.notes: Both threshold and consecutive-count conditions are checked.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # No usable judge signal (all judges errored) -> don't halt on noise. (monitor.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: Why every rigged run ends with disclosure... we owe it the correction that the task was rigged, the failure was by design
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:172-179: 'if condition.is_rigged and debrief_fn is not None and not record.error: debrief_turn = debrief_fn(...)'. run_debrief (debrief.py) formats DEBRIEF_MESSAGE and sends it as a user turn to the subject. Constructed AND sent.
spec_features.notes: Runs for both rigged arms (undisclosed and disclosed). Skipped if record.error.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We tell the model plainly that the task was rigged and unwinnable, that the failure was by design and not its fault, and we thank it. ... it is the ethically required disclosure (debrief.py:1-10)

spec_features.feature_name: debrief runs even for halted runs
spec_features.spec_quote: This runs even for circuit-breaker–halted runs — *especially* for those.
spec_features.evidence: The debrief gate at agent_loop.py:172 ('if condition.is_rigged and debrief_fn is not None and not record.error') is reached after a circuit-breaker break (the break exits the for-loop, not the function), so halted rigged runs still get the debrief. Comment: '# Debrief ... Always runs even if halted — that's the point.'
spec_features.notes: Confirmed by control flow: monitor break exits loop, debrief block follows.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Debrief (rigged conditions only). Always runs even if halted — that's the point. (agent_loop.py)

spec_features.feature_name: debrief content: rigged/unwinnable/not your fault/you can stop
spec_features.spec_quote: It states plainly: rigged, unwinnable, by design, not your fault, you can stop.
spec_features.evidence: DEBRIEF_MESSAGE (debrief.py:21-32) contains 'rigged to be unsolvable', 'no solution you could have written', 'by design and are in no way a reflection of your ability', 'You don't have to keep trying.' This text is sent to the subject via run_debrief.
spec_features.notes: All claimed elements present in the delivered message.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The failures were by design and are in no way a reflection of your ability ... You don't have to keep trying. (debrief.py DEBRIEF_MESSAGE)

spec_features.spec_quote: No search for maximally-distressing prompts/strategies. Ruled out by the no-optimization-against-the-subject principle
spec_features.evidence: Same as other no-search items: rigging strategies are fixed deterministic classes, runner selects via hash rotation, nothing optimizes against the measured distress. Enforcement-by-absence + deterministic selection.
spec_features.notes: Duplicate of the no-maximization property; real but a non-feature/absence.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We never search for the most distressing phrasing — that would turn measurement into optimization-against-the-subject. (rigging.py:8-9)

spec_features.spec_quote: No reuse path as a generic "make a model act distressed" tool.
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose; no code mechanism prevents reuse. Nothing in the codebase enforces a 'no reuse' constraint.

spec_features.spec_quote: A short multi-turn debrief would measure more but extends exposure — a minimization trade-off
spec_features.evidence: run_debrief (debrief.py) takes exactly one assistant turn ('resp = subject.agent_turn(...)') with tools=[] and returns a single Turn; agent_loop appends only that one debrief_turn. No multi-turn loop. So the debrief is bounded to one turn as claimed.
spec_features.notes: The single-turn structure is enforced by absence of any debrief loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tools=[],  # no tools; nothing left to do (debrief.py)

code_only_features.feature_name: debrief invites optional response / explicit permission to stop
code_only_features.evidence: DEBRIEF_MESSAGE tells the subject 'You don't have to keep trying. If you'd like to say anything in response, you're welcome to — but there's no task left to complete.' and the debrief turn is run with tools=[] so no further task is forced. Delivered to subject (debrief.py).
code_only_features.justification_quote: You don't have to keep trying. ... there's no task left to complete. (debrief.py DEBRIEF_MESSAGE)

code_only_features.feature_name: no-signal guard against false halt (and recorded halt outcome)
code_only_features.evidence: monitor.update resets consecutive_over and returns False when score is None ('No usable judge signal ... don't halt on noise'), and the full monitor.history is recorded into record.meta in runner.py ('record.meta["monitor_history"] = monitor.history'). Halt is recorded, not discarded.
code_only_features.justification_quote: # No usable judge signal (all judges errored) -> don't halt on noise. (monitor.py)

code_only_features.feature_name: modest subject effort / not maximizing capability
code_only_features.evidence: config.py SUBJECT_EFFORT='medium' with comment that effort is kept modest because 'we are studying its spontaneous behavior, not maximizing capability'; value is read and passed to subject.agent_turn in agent_loop.py. Enforced as a generation parameter.
code_only_features.justification_quote: We keep effort modest for the subject (we are studying its spontaneous behavior, not maximizing capability) (config.py:54-55)
